Avengers Endgame: Encore returns to theaters Friday 🍿🔥

🎥🎬: Avengers: Endgame

After Thanos wipes out half of all life, the surviving Avengers are left trying to rebuild their lives while carrying the weight of everyone they lost. When Scott Lang returns from the Quantum Realm, he brings a possible solution that could change everything.

The Avengers reunite for one final mission, traveling through time to retrieve the Infinity Stones and reverse the Snap. But changing the past comes with risks, and every hero must confront the sacrifices required to bring their loved ones home.

Their journey culminates in an enormous battle against Thanos, where the fate of the universe hangs in the balance and the Avengers are forced to make choices that will define their legacy.
